# Miami University

> > Miami University is a public research university in Oxford, Ohio, offering undergraduate and graduate programs with comprehensive admission services, research opportunities, and student support.

Miami University's website serves prospective students, transfer applicants, international students, school counselors, and researchers. The Office of Admission provides detailed resources for application processes, campus visits, tuition information, and personalized support through dedicated admission representatives across Ohio and internationally.

## Key Topics

- Miami University
- Oxford, Ohio
- Office of Admission
- Transfer Students

- Undergraduate Programs

## Admission and Applications

- [Admission and Aid](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/tour-guides/fall-spring-application-process/index.html): Main admission hub for undergraduate, graduate, and transfer applicants
- [Apply to Miami's Oxford Campus](https://www.miamioh.edu/apply2021sc/index.html): Oxford Campus application requirements and deadlines for all student types
- [Tuition and Cost of Attendance](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/tuition-fees/index.html): Tuition, fees, and housing costs with Tuition Promise guarantee details
- [Transfer Student Application Requirements](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/transfer/application/index.html): Transfer student application requirements and admission process details
- [Transfer Student Viewbook](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/transfer-viewbook/index.html): Transfer student viewbook with application requirements and resources
- [Visit Miami's Oxford Campus](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/visit-opps/tours-tunes/index.html): Oxford Campus visit options including tours, open house, and virtual visits

## International Students

- [International Students from South Korea](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/international/south-korea/index.html): South Korean student resources featuring KASA and student testimonials

## Research and Funding

- [Research Proposals](https://www.miamioh.edu/research/proposal-prep/index.html): Cayuse proposal system guide with grant writing and budget resources
- [Student Research Funding](https://www.miamioh.edu/research/finding-funding/funding-students/index.html): Student research funding with IRB, IACUC, and IBC compliance guidance

## Admission Support and Staff

- [Meet Your Admission Representative - Ohio](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/meet-the-staff/ohio/index.html): Directory of Ohio admission representatives including Agee, Arnett, Bakonyi
- [Meet Your Admission Representative](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/meet-the-staff/cheng/index.html): Admission staff directory with recruitment team contact information
- [Admission Resources for School Counselors](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/school-counselors/news-article/index.html): Counselor resources for Common App, FAFSA, transcripts, and scholarships
- [Admission Waitlist](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/high-school/waitlist/index.html): Waitlist FAQ and enrollment status information for applicants

## Optional

- [Farmer School of Business Student Profiles](https://www.miamioh.edu/admission/divisional-profiles/fsb-profiles/index.html): Farmer School of Business student profiles featuring Joshua Salzman
- [Assistant Professor Clara do Amaral - Science Friday](https://www.miamioh.edu/sciencefriday/do-amaral/index.html): Clara do Amaral's research on freeze-tolerant Alaskan wood frogs
